section_title: Hundreds of Brands, Decades Apart, One Safe Harbor

events.title: Japanese conglomerates dominate global Hi-Fi
events.description: Sony · Matsushita (Technics) · Pioneer · Yamaha · Kenwood · JVC · Sansui · Onkyo · Aiwa held 55%+ of global Hi-Fi share by 1982, from entry-level to premium big-box tiers.

events.title: Specialty retail differentiates with esoteric brands
events.description: Tweeter, Magnolia Hi-Fi, Crutchfield, and regional independents used Bose as entry and built reputations on Polk, Boston Acoustics, Snell, Advent, EPI, JBL, Infinity, ADS — often PE/KE owned even then.

events.title: Aspirational tier: the "eff you money" customer
events.description: Krell, Wilson Audio, Quad, Magnepan, McIntosh, Mark Levinson, conrad-johnson, Audio Research, Threshold, Bryston — $1M+ systems were not a stretch.

events.title: Bang & Olufsen stood alone — peak ~$853M USD
events.description: Equivalent to ≈ $1.25B in 2026 dollars. You had to put in the work to acquire B&O — the audio equivalent of the Birkin bag.

events.title: Chinese vendors + global PE roll-ups dominate
events.description: GoerTek/Dynaudio · IAG (Mission, Quad, Audiolab, Wharfedale) · Marshall family + HSG (Jan 2025) · Cosonic/Beyerdynamic. Same shape as the Japanese wave, different flag.

events.title: US specialty chain collapse
events.description: Tweeter, et al. — bankrupt 2007, closed Dec 2 2008. Big-box channel replaced by Amazon, JD, Taobao, Media Markt, Elkjøp.

events.title: Survivors
events.description: Crutchfield (1974) still private — $230M revenue, 50 years in. Magnolia absorbed inside Best Buy. Regional independents survive via custom install.

events.title: Krell closes
events.description: Following the death of owner/CEO Rondi D'Agostino. Service resumes Mar 2025; son Kristofer awarded 70%+ Feb 2025. Dan D'Agostino — rebuilt under his own name — is selling $250K monoblocks into Dolby Atmos maximalists.

events.title: B&O publicly traded, struggling
events.description: FY2023/24 revenue $402M — down from the 2007/08 peak.
